text:
alex_marketing: Hey runtime team — marketing needs a targeted rerun for the launch claim deck. Can you run a focused sweep for long-context / long-tail prompts on two quantized variants (int8 and q4f16) so we can validate cold-start and tail percentiles? We need raw CSVs and the per-request traces.

Requirements: minimal noise, 1M tokens total per variant (roughly 25k requests), include warmup policy, measure cold-starts, record p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, and include token-level billing estimates. Use the same prompt seed set we used for the July webinar (seed: 20240714).

Sample payload (please run both with same RNG seed):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open-70b",
  "input": "<seeded-prompt-collection>",
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "temperature": 0.0
}
```

alex_marketing: Also: please preserve original client headers in traces, and tag artifacts with `marketing-launch-v1` and variant label (int8/q4f16). We want links to S3 artifacts and a short summary table in the thread when done. :eyes:

jamie_runtime: Ack — can do. Quick clarifying Qs:
1) Which hardware to run on? we have capped Dedicated g4dn pool and private p4d cluster. Which do you want for the headline numbers?
2) Do you need streaming vs non-streaming traces? streaming adds a bit of overhead but matches prod.
3) Warmup policy: do you want 5 sample warmup requests or a full 2-minute steady-state warmup?

alex_marketing: Thanks Jamie. For headline marketing numbers pick the p4d cluster (closest to enterprise target). For reproducibility run both variants on the same hardware. Use streaming traces (we call streaming in prod). For warmup: do 2-minute steady-state warmup.

riley_eng: tagging in — I can provision the run and attach a job id. Will mirror the request and include the exact CLI commands. One small ask: we should cap concurrency to 32 to reflect typical client behavior; otherwise throughput numbers look unrealistically high.

riley_eng: CLI snippet I'll use to kick off the job (for audit):
```bash
redwood-cli jobs submit \n  --model redwood-open-70b \n  --variant int8 \n  --hardware p4d \n  --concurrency 32 \n  --seed 20240714 \n  --warmup 120 \n  --requests 25000 \n  --tag marketing-launch-v1:int8 \n  --output s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/
```

deploy-bot: Job queued — job_id=job-2026-05-12-4632, estimated runtime ~3h per variant.

alex_marketing: Awesome — please schedule int8 first, then q4f16 immediately after with identical traffic distribution. Can you also capture sample outputs for 100 representative prompts (we'll use for quality spot checks)?

jamie_runtime: Will do. ETA: we'll post preliminary CSVs and a 1-slide summary in this thread within 48 hours. Full traces and S3 links once both runs complete (~6h total). We'll include cold-start counts per instance and a column for quantization artifacts (e.g., decoding retries).

riley_eng: Started int8 run now, job_id=job-2026-05-12-4632-int8. Posting live tail of the metrics:
```
requests_received,requests_served,p50_ms,p90_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cold_starts
250,250,82,140,210,380,3
1000,1000,85,145,218,395,8
5000,5000,88,150,225,420,22
```

alex_marketing: Nice — can you make sure the CSV includes these columns: request_id, model, variant, hardware, start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, cold_start_bool, run_tag? That will let us join to our analytics pipeline.

jamie_runtime: Yep — we'll include that schema and also a small README.yml in S3 with run parameters and exact binary/commit used.

riley_eng: quick note: we observed a handful of decoding retries on q4f16 in preliminary tests; we'll flag them in the artifact with `decoding_retry_reason`.

alex_marketing: Perfect. Last ask: when you post the CSVs, include a single-line executive summary like `int8: p50 85ms, p95 220ms, p99 410ms, cold-starts 25; q4f16: ...` so comms can pull soundbites. :thumbsup:

jamie_runtime: Will post results + S3 links here. Thanks team.

riley_eng: Done for int8: S3 artifacts at https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/int8/ (files: run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). Kicking q4f16 now (job_id=job-2026-05-12-4632-q4f16).

alex_marketing: Thank you!! Please @channel when both are complete so we can prep slides.

deploy-bot: job job-2026-05-12-4632-int8 completed successfully.

jamie_runtime: q4f16 done too. Artifacts: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/q4f16/ (run.csv, traces.tar.gz, README.yml). Executive summary: int8: p50 86ms, p95 222ms, p99 408ms, cold-starts 27; q4f16: p50 120ms, p95 310ms, p99 615ms, cold-starts 42.

alex_marketing: This is great — will hand to comms and design. Can you also export a small sample of 50 (input+output) JSONs for legal/QA review?

riley_eng: Yep — uploading 50-sample JSON to s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/launch-v1/samples/ now.

alex_marketing: Amazing. Closing this ask for now — we'll follow up if we need deeper slices. :raised_hands:
